recipe.title: Beetroot, Green Lentil & Feta Wholegrain Wraps with Rocket and Dijon-Herb Yoghurt
recipe.description: Portable wholegrain wraps filled with earthy beetroot, seasoned green lentils, salty feta and peppery rocket, served with a thick Dijon-parsley yoghurt for a bright, creamy finish without making the wraps soggy.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 2 medium wraps, 1 per serving; retail size and nutrition vary.
ingredients.preparation: Keep sealed until assembly so the wraps remain flexible.
ingredients.notes: Whole wraps do not scale perfectly for every serving quantity; round sensibly when scaling.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 190 g drained lentils; drained yield varies and some lentils may remain for another meal.
ingredients.preparation: Drain, rinse thoroughly and drain again.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 160 g plain cooked beetroot; choose beetroot not preserved in vinegar. Pack size may vary.
ingredients.preparation: Drain any package liquid and pat thoroughly dry.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 50 g; retail pack size may vary.

ingredients.preparation: Wash if required and dry thoroughly.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 240 g; retail pot size may vary.
ingredients.notes: Use a thick strained yoghurt so the sauce works as a dip without running into the wraps.
Provides acidity to both the lentil filling and yoghurt sauce.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 15 g leaves and tender stems.

ingredients.notes: Feta, mustard and wraps supply additional salt.
Use 1/4 tsp in the lentils and 1/4 tsp in the yoghurt sauce.

equipment.notes: For rinsing and thoroughly draining the lentils.
For the beetroot and lentil filling.

equipment.display_name: 2 lunch containers with 2 small sauce pots
equipment.notes: Keep the yoghurt sauce separate from the wraps during transport.

mise_en_place.instruction: Drain the green lentils into the colander, rinse thoroughly under cold running water, then shake firmly and leave them to drain while preparing the other ingredients.
mise_en_place.endpoint: The lentils are cool, clean-tasting and sufficiently dry that no water collects beneath the colander.

mise_en_place.instruction: Pat the cooked beetroot thoroughly dry, then cut it into approximately 8 mm dice. Crumble the feta into pieces approximately 5-10 mm across. Check that the rocket is completely dry.
mise_en_place.endpoint: The beetroot is evenly diced without excessive surface liquid, the feta is coarsely crumbled and the rocket is dry.

mise_en_place.instruction: Finely chop the parsley leaves and tender stems.
mise_en_place.endpoint: The parsley is finely and evenly chopped without being crushed into a paste.

procedure.title: Make the Dijon-herb yoghurt
procedure.instruction: Combine the 240 g Greek yoghurt with 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp lemon juice, approximately two-thirds of the chopped parsley and 1/4 tsp black pepper. Stir until completely even.
procedure.endpoint: The sauce is thick, smooth and spoonable, with clear mustard acidity and fresh parsley flavour.

corrective_actions.condition: The sauce seems excessively thick for dipping.
corrective_actions.action: Stir in 1 tsp cold water; add no more unless required.

procedure.title: Season the lentils and beetroot
procedure.instruction: Place the well-drained lentils and diced beetroot in the mixing bowl. Add the remaining 1 tbsp lemon juice, remaining chopped parsley, 1/8 tsp fine salt and remaining 1/4 tsp black pepper. Fold gently until evenly seasoned, then fold through the crumbled feta, keeping distinct pieces of cheese visible.
procedure.endpoint: The filling tastes bright, savoury and properly seasoned, with no watery liquid pooling in the bottom of the bowl and distinct pieces of beetroot and feta remaining.

corrective_actions.condition: Liquid accumulates at the bottom of the bowl.
corrective_actions.action: Transfer the mixture briefly to the colander and allow the excess liquid to drain before filling the wraps.

procedure.title: Layer the wraps
procedure.instruction: Lay the 2 wholemeal wraps flat. Divide the 40 g rocket between them, arranging it in a strip across the central third of each wrap. Divide the beetroot, lentil and feta mixture evenly over the rocket, leaving approximately 40 mm clear at the left and right edges.
procedure.endpoint: Each wrap contains an even portion of filling positioned centrally, with the dry rocket forming a barrier between the moist filling and the tortilla.

corrective_actions.condition: The filling is piled too high for the wrap to close comfortably.
corrective_actions.action: Spread it into a longer, narrower strip rather than compressing it into a mound.

procedure.title: Roll the wraps tightly
procedure.instruction: Fold the left and right edges of each tortilla inward over the filling. Bring the lower edge firmly over the filling, compress gently, then continue rolling away from you into a tight cylinder with the seam underneath.
procedure.endpoint: Each wrap is tightly enclosed with both ends folded in, no loose filling escaping and the seam secured underneath.

corrective_actions.condition: The tortilla begins to split while rolling.
corrective_actions.action: Reduce the compression force and leave the wrap whole rather than attempting to tighten it further.

procedure.title: Pack the yoghurt separately
procedure.instruction: Place 1 wrap into each lunch container. Divide the Dijon-herb yoghurt evenly between 2 sealed small sauce pots, giving approximately 120 g per serving. Keep the sauce separate until eating.
procedure.endpoint: Each lunch contains 1 sealed wrap and 1 separate portion of thick Dijon-herb yoghurt with no sauce contacting the tortilla during storage.

plating.instruction: Serve each wholegrain wrap with its portion of Dijon-herb yoghurt. Dip each bite into the yoghurt or spoon small amounts into the open end as the wrap is eaten, keeping the remaining tortilla dry and structured.

storage.storage_instructions: Refrigerate the assembled wraps and Dijon-herb yoghurt promptly and use within 24 hours for the best texture. Keep the yoghurt in separate sealed sauce pots. For transport to work or on a car journey, keep the lunch chilled in an insulated bag with an ice pack and refrigerate on arrival where possible. The seasoned lentil-beetroot filling and yoghurt sauce may separately be refrigerated for up to 2 days before final assembly.

either_retailer: Medium wholemeal tortilla wraps — 1 pack; use 2.
Canned green lentils — 1 approximately 400 g tin; use 190 g drained.
Plain cooked beetroot — 1 pack; use 160 g.
Fresh flat-leaf parsley — 1 small pack; use 15 g.

restaurant_quality_features: Earthy beetroot and lentils are sharpened with lemon rather than left tasting heavy.
Salty feta provides concentrated savoury contrast without requiring a large quantity.
Peppery rocket adds freshness and creates a practical moisture barrier inside the wrap.
Dijon, parsley and lemon turn high-protein Greek yoghurt into a strongly flavoured creamy accompaniment.
Keeping the yoghurt separate maintains tortilla structure during transport.
Distinct beetroot, feta, lentil and rocket textures are preserved rather than mixing everything into a uniform filling.
nutrition_notes: Approximately 450 kcal and 31.5 g protein per serving.
Green lentils, Greek yoghurt and feta collectively provide sufficient protein for the lunch target.
Lentils, beetroot, rocket and wholegrain wraps contribute substantial fibre.
The yoghurt sauce increases protein and creaminess without requiring mayonnaise or a large amount of oil.
Nutrition values are estimates and will vary with the exact wrap, yoghurt, feta and lentil products used.
critical_success_factors: Drain both the lentils and beetroot thoroughly so the wraps do not become soggy.
Keep the rocket dry before assembly.
Use the rocket as the first layer between the tortilla and moist filling.
Roll firmly enough to contain the filling without splitting the tortilla.
Keep the Dijon-herb yoghurt separate until eating.
Maintain refrigeration during storage and transport.
